presentationProfile.title: Saleshandy
presentationProfile.description: Saleshandy helps sales teams find prospects and manage cold email outreach.

AnalyticsController_exportEmailSentDetai.description: Export sent email details for the selected sequences and date range as a CSV sent to your account email.

AnalyticsController_getAllTeamSummarized.description: Return team performance statistics for the selected users and reporting period.

AnalyticsController_getEmailAccountStats.description: Return engagement, sentiment, and performance statistics for the specified email account.

AnalyticsController_getSequenceConsolida.description: Return engagement statistics across the selected sequences and date range.

AnalyticsController_getSequenceStats.description: Return prospect and email performance statistics for the specified sequence.

AttachmentController_uploadAttachment.description: Upload a file as multipart/form-data with a file field. Use the returned attachmentId in an email-step variant; use POST /v1/notes/attachments for note files.

ClientController_assignResource.description: Assign the specified sequences or email accounts to a client.

ClientController_createClient.description: Create a client using the supplied name, email, company, and permission details.

ClientController_getClientLists.description: List clients with optional search, pagination, and sorting.

DncController_addItemsToDncList.displayName: Add items to a do-not-contact list
DncController_addItemsToDncList.description: Add the supplied domains or email addresses to a do-not-contact list.

DncController_getDncById.displayName: Get items in a do-not-contact list
DncController_getDncById.description: Return items from a do-not-contact list, with optional search and item type filters.

DncController_getDncListWithItem.description: Search for a do-not-contact item across all lists.

DncController_getDncLists.description: List do-not-contact lists with optional search, pagination, and sorting.

DomainBlacklistController_addBlacklistDo.description: Add the supplied domains to the account blacklist.

DomainController_deleteDomain.description: Soft-delete an active domain and remove its mailboxes from sending rotation. Other statuses are rejected. AnnualFlexi orders reserve a replacement slot; other plans do not. Restore with POST /v1/domain/{id}/revoke. Final registrar removal is asynchronous; use the domain id from GET /v1/domain, not the orderId.

DomainController_generateMailboxNames.displayName: Generate mailbox name suggestions for a sender
DomainController_generateMailboxNames.description: Generate mailbox address suggestions from a sender name and domain. count must be between 1 and 100.

DomainController_getDomainPlans.description: List domain prices by email provider, TLD, and plan type. annualFlexi and annualFixed are available for Google and Microsoft; Azure offers quarterly plans. Renewal plans are identified by isRenewalPlan.

DomainController_getOrderStatus.description: Return the domains and mailboxes in an order with provisioning status. Poll until each domain leaves inProgress; statuses include active, deleted, failed, and expired. Use an orderId from GET /v1/domain/orders or the purchase response.

DomainController_listDomainOrders.displayName: List all domain purchase orders wit
DomainController_listDomainOrders.description: List domain purchase orders with billing and plan details. For domain names, mailbox addresses, and provisioning status, use GET /v1/domain or GET /v1/domain/orders/{orderId}.

DomainController_listDomains.description: List purchased domains and mailboxes with provisioning status. Poll until status changes from inProgress to active. Use domains[].id to delete or restore a domain.

DomainController_purchaseDomain.description: Order domains and mailboxes from the selected email provider. Paid orders return a checkoutUrl; free orders return an orderId. Provisioning is asynchronous, so poll GET /v1/domain. redirectUrl must be a bare domain, phoneNumber must use E.164, and country must be ISO alpha-2.

DomainController_revokeDomain.displayName: Restore a previously deleted domain (undo delete)
DomainController_revokeDomain.description: Restore a domain with deleted status to active and release any reserved AnnualFlexi slot. Other statuses are rejected. This restores only the specified domain; use its id from GET /v1/domain.

DomainController_searchDomains.description: Search available domain names by a 3-254 character keyword without a TLD and an email service provider (Google, Microsoft, or Azure). Optionally filter by TLD and page. Use returned names when ordering domains.

DomainController_uploadProfilePicture.displayName: Upload a profile pic for a sending domain mailbox
DomainController_uploadProfilePicture.description: Upload a PNG, JPG, or GIF profile picture as multipart/form-data (maximum 1 MB). Use the returned id as profilePicId when ordering a domain; set profilePicId to 0 to skip it.

EmailAccountController_addEmailAccounts.displayName: Connect new sending email accounts SMTP and IMAP
EmailAccountController_addEmailAccounts.description: Start an asynchronous email-account connection. The response includes a requestId; poll GET /v1/email-accounts/connect/status/{requestId} for progress and the resulting CSV link.

EmailAccountController_connectEmailAccou.description: Connect an SMTP/IMAP sending account. The account is saved even if verification fails; inspect smtpConnection and imapConnection in the response. Status 0 means unverified; 1 means connected. emailServiceProvider is lowercase (zoho, gmail, yahoo, sendgrid, mailgun, ses, or outlook); provide fromName, fromFirstName, and fromLastName.

EmailAccountController_getEmailAccounts.description: List email accounts matching the supplied filters and pagination settings.

EmailAccountController_getEmailAccountsC.description: Check the progress of an email-account connection or reconnection and retrieve its CSV result link.

EmailAccountController_reconnectEmailAcc.description: Start an asynchronous reconnection of email accounts. Use the returned requestId with GET /v1/email-accounts/connect/status/{requestId} to check progress and retrieve the CSV link.

EmailAccountController_updateEmailAccoun.description: Update settings for the listed email accounts, including sender details, quotas, signatures, sending intervals, ramp-up, or client assignment.

FieldController_createField.description: Creates a new custom field that can be used to store additional information on prospect profiles. Supported field types are Text, Number, Long Text, Currency, Date, and Dropdown.

FieldController_getFields.description: List account fields. Set systemFields=true to include built-in fields; omit it or set false to return custom fields only. Each field includes its resolved tags.

FieldController_updateField.description: Updates the label, fallback text, and/or tags of an existing custom field. Only custom (non-system) fields can be updated. Use the field ID returned by the GET /fields endpoint.

LeadFinderController_aiChat.description: Run a natural-language search and return the assistant response with up to 25 matching leads or companies when results are found.

LeadFinderController_bulkAddLeadsToSeque.description: Add up to 10,000 lead-finder leads to a sequence step, optionally assigning existing or new tags.

LeadFinderController_enrichCompanies.description: Start company enrichment for up to 100 companies using domains, website URLs, company IDs, or LinkedIn URLs. An optional webhook can receive completion results.

LeadFinderController_enrichLeads.description: Start contact enrichment for up to 100 people using LinkedIn URLs, lead IDs, or name and company details. An optional webhook can receive completion results.

LeadFinderController_getCreditDetails.description: Return the account credit balance and usage summary.

LeadFinderController_getEnrichmentResult.description: Return the results of a completed enrichment job.

LeadFinderController_getEnrichmentStatus.description: Return the status of a people or company enrichment job.

LeadFinderController_getLeadFinderFilter.description: Return the lead search filters available on the current plan.

LeadFinderController_getRateLimitStatus.description: Return the current API rate-limit status for the account.

LeadFinderController_searchCompanies.description: Search for companies using the supplied company, location, industry, funding, size, and other filters.

LeadFinderController_searchLeads.description: Search for people using the supplied lead, role, location, and company filters.

LeadsToEmailController_createDomainsWork.description: Start a workflow that finds people at the supplied company domains, enriches them, and sends the results to your webhook.

LeadsToEmailController_createWorkflow.description: Content-Type: multipart/form-data with a file field (the CSV) plus the text fields below. JSON-valued fields (columnMapping, exportColumns, filters) must be sent as stringified JSON.

NoteController_createNote.description: Create a note for one prospect with prospectId or for several with prospectIds. The response reports the result for each prospect.

NoteController_updateNote.description: Updates the content or visibility of an existing note. Only the fields you provide will be changed — any field you omit will remain unchanged. Use the note ID returned when the note was created.

NoteController_uploadNoteAttachment.displayName: Upload an attachment for a note
NoteController_uploadNoteAttachment.description: Upload a note attachment as multipart/form-data with one file field. Files can be up to 20 MB; use the returned attachmentId when creating a note.

ProspectController_getProspectAttributeB.description: Retrieve the long-text field value for a prospect attribute using its attribute ID and, optionally, a prospect ID.

ProspectController_getProspectImportStat.description: Check the progress of an import started through either prospect-import endpoint. The response includes any import errors as a CSV link.

ProspectController_getProspectNotes.description: Returns a paginated list of notes attached to the specified prospect, along with any draft note and pagination metadata. Use the skip and take query parameters to page through results.

ProspectController_getProspectsVerificat.description: Return email verification statuses for the submitted addresses.

ProspectController_importProspects.description: Import prospects from the supplied list. Optionally assign a sequence step, verify email addresses, and choose how to handle existing prospects.

ProspectController_importProspectsV2.description: Submit an asynchronous prospect import using existing field names. Each request supports up to 100,000 prospects and 90 MB. The response includes a requestId for GET /v1/prospects/import-status/{requestId}; import errors are returned in a CSV file.

ProspectController_upsertAttribute.description: Update one field with fieldId and attributeValue, or update multiple fields with an attributes array of fieldId/value pairs. Use field IDs from GET /v1/fields.

ScheduleController_createSchedule.description: Create a sending schedule using a name, IANA time zone, and per-day timeSlots. Set isDefault=true to assign it automatically to new sequences without a scheduleId.

ScheduleController_getSchedules.description: List schedules available to the caller. Use a schedule id when creating or updating a sequence; the default schedule is assigned when no id is supplied.

SequenceContactController_assignTagsToPr.description: Create or reuse the supplied tags and assign them to prospects identified by ID or email.

SequenceContactController_findProspects.description: List prospects with search, pagination, sorting, and optional custom fields.

SequenceContactController_findTags.description: List prospect tags, optionally filtered by tag name.

SequenceContactController_getContactMini.description: Return the sequence history for the specified contact.

SequenceContactController_unAssignTagsTo.description: Remove the specified tags from the identified prospects.

SequenceContactController_unsubscribePro.description: Unsubscribe the prospects identified in the request.

SequenceContactController_updateProspect.description: Update the status of the specified prospects. A pause delay applies when the requested status is paused.

SequenceController_addContactsToSequence.displayName: Add prospects to a sequence step
SequenceController_addContactsToSequence.description: Add the specified contacts to a step in the sequence.

SequenceController_addEmailAccountToSequ.description: Attach the specified email accounts to the sequence.

SequenceController_createSequence.description: Create a sequence with a title and optional sending accounts and schedule. All supplied account and schedule IDs are validated before creation; if validation or account limits fail, no sequence is created. If omitted, the default sending account is attached.

SequenceController_createStep.displayName: Create a new step for a sequence
SequenceController_createStep.description: Add a step to the sequence. Provide a channel, absoluteDays (1-999), and at least one channel-specific variant; email steps allow up to 26 variants, while each day can contain at most one email step. Task-generating steps can include priority and assignee.

SequenceController_createVariant.displayName: Add a new variant to an existing step
SequenceController_createVariant.description: Append a variant to an existing step. Email steps support up to 26 variants; other channels support one. The payload must match the step channel: email uses subject/content, LinkedIn connection requests use connectionNote, messages use message, and other supported channels use their documented payload.

SequenceController_getSequenceSettings.displayName: Get sequence settings (optionally filter by code)
SequenceController_getSequenceSettings.description: Return the sequence settings, assigned schedule, priority distribution, and client. Pass code (1-13) to retrieve one setting.

SequenceController_getSequenceStepVarian.description: Return the variants configured for the specified sequence step.

SequenceController_getSequenceSteps.displayName: List all steps and variants for a sequence
SequenceController_getSequenceSteps.description: Return every step in the sequence, in execution order, each with its variants and their payloads. Useful for exporting a sequence or for inspecting what will be sent.

SequenceController_getSequencesWithSteps.description: List sequences with their steps. Filter by sequence title and paginate or sort the results.

SequenceController_importProspectsV2.displayName: Import prospects into a sequence using field names
SequenceController_importProspectsV2.description: Submit an asynchronous prospect import into a sequence using existing field names. Each request supports up to 100,000 prospects and 90 MB. Use the returned requestId with GET /v1/prospects/import-status/{requestId}; errors are provided as a CSV link.

SequenceController_removeEmailAccountFro.description: Remove the specified email accounts from the sequence.

SequenceController_sendTestEmail.description: Send a test email from an account attached to the sequence using the supplied recipients, subject, and HTML content.

SequenceController_sequenceEmailAccountL.description: List sending email accounts attached to the specified sequence.

SequenceController_updatePriorityDistrib.displayName: Update priority distribution for a sequence
SequenceController_updatePriorityDistrib.description: Set the sequence email priority preset: 1 prioritizes follow-ups, 2 prioritizes new prospects, 3 balances steps, and 4 sends up to 80% from the first step. Provide priorityDistributionId.

SequenceController_updateProspectOutcome.description: Set an outcome for the specified prospect emails, optionally limiting the update to a sequence and setting a deal value.

SequenceController_updateSequenceSchedul.displayName: Update the schedule assigned to a sequence
SequenceController_updateSequenceSchedul.description: Assign a schedule to the sequence by passing its hashed scheduleId. The schedule controls sending days and time windows; use GET /v1/schedules to list available schedules.

SequenceController_updateSequenceSetting.description: Update only the setting codes supplied; other settings stay unchanged. Code 1 must contain {{link}} unless blank to disable it, and can use an accepted preset or custom HTML. Codes 1 and 2 are mutually exclusive; setting one clears the other.

SequenceController_updateSequenceStatus.description: Pause or resume the selected sequences.

SequenceController_updateVariant.displayName: Update a step variant for a sequence
SequenceController_updateVariant.description: Update the payload, status, taskNote, priority, assigneeId, or attachmentIds of an existing variant. The payload shape must match the step's channel (see OpenAPI.md).

SequenceController_verifyProspects.description: Start email verification for prospects in the specified sequence.

SubsequenceController_createSubsequence.displayName: Create a new subsequence under a parent sequence
SubsequenceController_createSubsequence.description: Create a subsequence with a 1-200 character title and at least one trigger condition; conditions use AND logic. A default schedule is used if scheduleId is omitted. firstStepRelativeDays must be at least 1 when set. Add steps after creation using the returned id.

SubsequenceController_getSubsequenceSett.displayName: Get schedule, entry delay, & trigger conditions
SubsequenceController_getSubsequenceSett.description: Retrieve the current scheduleId, firstStepRelativeDays, and conditions[] configured on a subsequence. Use after Create Subsequence or Update Subsequence to read the live state.

SubsequenceController_listSubsequences.displayName: List all subsequences under a parent sequence
SubsequenceController_listSubsequences.description: List subsequences with progress and engagement metrics. Filter by progress (1 active, 2 paused, 3 finished), title search, or owner IDs.

SubsequenceController_updateSubsequence.displayName: Update the schedule, entry delay, or conditions
SubsequenceController_updateSubsequence.description: Update the schedule, entry delay, or conditions. Omitted fields stay unchanged; conditions replace the full set, and an empty conditions array does not clear them. Read the updated state with GET /v1/sequences/subsequence/{subsequenceId}/settings.

TaskController_bulkSkipTask.displayName: Skip multiple tasks at the same time
TaskController_bulkSkipTask.description: Skip up to 100 tasks asynchronously. The response returns a bulkActionId; check GET /v1/tasks/bulk-status/{bulkActionId} for progress and errors.

TaskController_bulkSnoozeTask.displayName: Snooze multiple tasks with snooze duration or Time
TaskController_bulkSnoozeTask.description: Snooze up to 10,000 tasks asynchronously. The response returns a bulkActionId; check GET /v1/tasks/bulk-status/{bulkActionId} for progress and errors.

TaskController_completeTask.description: Mark the specified task complete, optionally including a call outcome.

TaskController_createTask.description: Create a task for one prospect using prospectId, or create the same task for several prospects using prospectIds. The response reports each prospect result separately, so one failure does not affect the others.

TaskController_getAssigneeList.description: List users available to assign to tasks.

TaskController_getBulkTaskStatus.description: Check the progress of a bulk snooze or skip operation. The response includes error details and a CSV link when applicable.

TaskController_getTaskById.description: Return details for the specified task.

TaskController_getTaskCounts.description: Return task counts grouped by status.

TaskController_getTasks.description: List tasks with filters for status, sequence, assignee, prospect outcome, task type, and call outcome.

TaskController_snoozeTask.description: Snooze the specified task until the supplied time.

TaskController_updateTaskNote.description: Update the note on the specified task.

UniboxController_getCategories.description: Returns the list of reply categories used to classify inbound emails in the unified inbox (Unibox). Each category has a unique key, a display name, a sentiment (Positive, Negative, or Neutral), and a flag indicating whether it is a system default category or a custom one.

UnifiedInboxController_getAll.description: Return the number of unread email threads.

UnifiedInboxController_getAllEmails.description: Return all emails in the specified thread.

UnifiedInboxController_getEmailContentFo.description: Return the content of the specified email in a thread.

UnifiedInboxController_getEmailList.description: List inbox emails matching the supplied search, category, sentiment, date, owner, and account filters.

UnifiedInboxController_getFields.description: List inbox outcomes, optionally filtered by category.

UnifiedInboxController_replyOnEmail.description: Send a reply in the specified email thread, with optional CC, BCC, and attachments.

UserController_getTeamAndMemberList.description: List the account team and its members.

WebhookController_createWebhook.description: Register a webhook with its destination URL, subscribed events, and optional custom headers.

WebhookController_getWebhook.description: Return the webhook identified by its public ID.
